truyen-v1-the-ten.chu:
They were not lost in the roots. They stayed when the Silence came, binding their names to bronze so the tree might remember.
Beneath the hollow bell, a mother kept watch over four voices that would never answer.
And still, somewhere in the Heartwood, their final note waits to be heard.
